scripts.build: tsc -p . && for a in modes notes ml-worker voice voice-cleanup digest router usage-watch cost-guard workers; do cp src/addons/$a/tg-bridge-addon.json dist/addons/$a/; done && cp src/addons/usage-watch/check.py dist/addons/usage-watch/
scripts.test: node --test --experimental-strip-types test/*.test.ts && python3 -I -m unittest discover -s ml -p 'test_*.py' && python3 -I -m unittest discover -s test -p 'test_usage_*.py'
